name: Prerequisitor (Legendary Inquisitor Archetype)
body:
Religious faith and a strong will are not the only components of wisdom. There is also practical pragmatism. Prerequisitors trust in their own awareness of things when learning something new in order to improve themselves. When her intellect and creativity are not sufficient to help her improve, a prerequisitor relies on her open mind to better herself.

Requisite Qualifications (Ex)

A prerequisitor can use her Wisdom score in place of any other mental ability score (Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma) for the purpose of meeting requirements for selecting feats. In addition, she gains a bonus feat at levels 1 and 6.

This replaces domain.

Pragmatic (Ex)

Starting at 3rd level, a prerequisitor can use her Wisdom score in place of any physical ability score (Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution) for the purpose of meeting requirements for selecting feats.

This replaces solo tactics.

At 3rd level, and every three levels thereafter, the prerequisitor gains a bonus feat in addition to those gained from normal advancement. The prerequisitor must meet the prerequisites of the selected bonus feat.

This replaces the teamwork feats gained at these levels.
